name: bounded replay via immutable packed segments and snapshots
goal: Keep role-local continuation/replay practical without LFS, artifact/package storage, hosted runners or external object storage.

source_constraints.github_repository_limits: GitHub recommends individual objects around <=1 MB and directory width <=3000 entries; Contents API directory retrieval has a 1000-entry upper limit in its documented behavior.
source_constraints.event_sourcing: Snapshots can reduce rehydration cost while the append-only eventstream remains the source of truth.
source_constraints.merkle_optional: RFC 6962 demonstrates that Merkle roots/consistency proofs can verify append-only log extension with logarithmic proof size; this protocol does not require full Merkle implementation for the current small role-local log.

layout.loose_tail: at most K not-yet-packed events reachable after the latest snapshot
layout.packed_segment: immutable text file containing full canonical event bodies plus their hashes; target <=128 events and <=512 KiB
layout.epoch_directory: start a new directory after <=512 packed segments, keeping Contents-directory listing below 1000 items
layout.snapshot: immutable state plus object heads, through_segment hash and through_event_count
layout.publication_head: small mutable CAS file naming the current snapshot and any tail after it

safe_compaction_order: Create a canonical immutable packed segment for an already-authoritative event range.
Create an immutable snapshot whose state/object heads equal replay through that segment.
CAS-publish the new compact head/snapshot and read it back.
Only after successful publication may redundant loose source objects become garbage-collection candidates. GC failure is safe redundancy; GC before publication is forbidden.
After any CAS conflict, reconstruct and recompute segment boundaries against current authority.
audit_property: Packed segments preserve full event bodies, so state can be restored from the snapshot while detailed historical audit/replay can load segments on demand. A snapshot alone is not treated as the source of truth.

live_probe.audit_readback: packed segment read back with all four canonical event bodies and hashes
live_probe.reason_gc_not_run: The existing TX_HEAD still directly references the original per-object event graph and a cross-run pending operation depends on that test fixture. Deleting source events here would conflate the independent compaction replica with the active transaction probe.

boundedness.reconstruction_work_after_snapshot: O(K) tail events; current probe K-tail=0
boundedness.directory_width: <=512 segment files per epoch by protocol
boundedness.long_term_growth: one packed segment per up to 128 events plus snapshots; if segment count itself becomes material, add a higher-level content-addressed segment index/Merkle tree without changing publication/CAS semantics

quota_and_cost.repository_api: low-volume text transport only; rate-limit backoff rules from phase1_retry_state_machine_v1 apply

next_test: After the pending cross-run operation is completed, compact its resulting new events into a second segment/snapshot, CAS-publish a compact head update, then in an isolated duplicate fixture test post-publication deletion of redundant loose event copies and interruption during GC.
